title: Noor and the Sigil
author: Theo Vasquez
blurb: Sable Reyes, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
